spec.studio_prompt: A tall cylindrical rice paper pendant lamp shade measuring 22 cm in diameter and 45 cm in height. The main body is crafted from fibrous, semi-translucent off-white rice paper (#d9cec1, highlights in #f4f9fb) with a fine organic washi texture. The paper is stretched over an internal lightweight wire framework, displaying subtle linear vertical ribs and a distinct horizontal dividing line through the center (#b5aca0, shadowed at #8f734e). The cylinder has cleanly finished, open circular top and bottom rims, exhibiting a balanced 1:2 proportion and a pure, minimalist architectural silhouette.
